Char: Methods:
Study design: Cross-over randomised controlled clinical trial

Setting: not reported

Data of trial: February 2006 - December 2009

Follow-up: not reported

Country: not reported
Char: Participants:
Inclusion Criteria:

  •  Type 1 Diabetes for at least two years.
  • HbA1c ≤ 10.0%.
  • C-peptide < 0.05 nmol/L.
  • BMI ≤ 30 kg/m².
  • On an intensified insulin regimen (NPH or CSII) for at least 3 months.
  • Women not of childbearing potential or using reliable contraception.
  • Able and willing to perform self-monitoring of blood glucose.

Exclusion criteria: 

  • Cardiovascular Issues: History of myocardial infarction in the last year, unstable angina pectoris, or severe heart failure (NYHA Class III/IV).
  • Severe Complications: History of recurrent severe hypoglycemia, diabetic gastroparesis, or active proliferative diabetic retinopathy.
  • Organ Function: Signs of significant hepatic or renal disease, or clinically relevant anemia.
  • Substance Use: History of drug or alcohol abuse, or smoking more than 10 cigarettes per day.
  • Medication Use: Recent receipt of an investigational drug or current use of systemic corticosteroids or other drugs affecting blood glucose.
  • Other Conditions: Pre-planned surgery, history of hypersensitivity to insulin, or significant endogenous insulin secretion.
  • Blood Donation: Donated more than 500 mL of blood in the previous 3 months.
Char: Outcomes:
Primary outcome(s): serum insulin concentrations

Secondary outcome(s): 

  • glucose infusion rates
  • blood glucose concentrations
  • adverse events
  • hypoglycemic episodes collection
